Definition: from another form of G4128; to increase (transitively or intransitively):--abound, multiply.
BiblicalUsage: Plethyno means to multiply, to increase. The word of God increased and the number of disciples multiplied in Acts 6:7, and the word of God grew and multiplied in Acts 12:24. But Jesus warns that because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold, in Matthew 24:12, and Paul says God multiplies the seed sown in 2 Corinthians 9:10.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God multiplies what is His — His word, His people, His seed — and sin multiplies only coldness. My position is that I want to be part of the increase that warms, not the one that cools.
